paite: I saltan akum sawmnih-le-ngana, huai kum bul, huai kha ani sawmna, khopi siat nung akum sawm-le-lina, huai ni mahmah in TOUPA khut ka tung ah ahong om a, huai ah ahon pi hi.
heading: Tunung Tempul Ding Mengmuhna / (40.1-48.35) / Jerusalem Khopi Ah Ezekiel
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

paite: Pathian mengmuhna ah Israel gam ah ahon pi a, tang sangtak ah ahon koih a, huai simlam ah khopi dinsaksa bangtak a-om hi.
english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

paite: Huai ah ahon pi a, ngai dih, mi khat ana om a, amel latdan dal bang mai ahi a; khauzang leh tehna chiang atawi a, kongpi ah adingh hi.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

paite: Huan huai mi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na mit in en inla, na bil in za in; ka hon etsak ding lam ah na lungsim nga tinten in; huai ka hon etsak ding ziak a hiai a ka hon pi na hi ngal a; na muh tengteng Israel inkote kiang ah puang in," achi hi.
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

paite: Huan ngai dih, tempul kimvel ah kulhbaang ana om a, huai mi'n tehna chiang, tong guk a sau atawi a, atong khat bel tong khat leh khutpek bok chia ahi a; kulhbaang sahlam ateh a, chiang khep khat ahi a, asanlam leng chiang khep khat mah ahi.
heading: Suahlam Kongpi
english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

paite: Huchi in suahlam chial kongpi ahong tung a, akalbi ah apaitou a; kongpi lutna dantan ateh a, chiang khep khat a za ahi.
english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

paite: Huan vilna dantante adunglam chiang khep khat, availam chiang khep khat chiat ahi; vilna dantan kikal tong nga chiat ahi a; huan Inpi lam kongpi sumtawng kongpi lutna dantan chiang khep khat ahi.
english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

paite: Inpi lam sumtawng leng ateh a, tong giat ahi.
english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

paite: Abaangkate tong nih chiat ahi a, kongpi sumtawng inpi lam ah ahi.
english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

paite: Huan suahlam kongpi vilna dantante alang tuak ah thum tuaktuak ahi a, athum un akikim vek uhi; huan, baangkate leng alang tuak ah akikim ahi.
english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

paite: Kongpi lutna vailam ateh a, tong sawm ahi a; kongpi paisuakna vailam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

paite: Huan vilna dantan ma ah deidanna langkhat ah tong khat a sah tuaktuak a-om a; huchi in vilna dantante lang tuak tong guk tuak ahi hi.
english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

paite: Huan kongpi ateh a, vilna dantan khat tung a kipan alangkhat tung pha in tong sawmnih-le-nga a za ahi; kongkhak leh kongkhak kizom chiat in.
english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

paite: Sumtawng leng ateh a, tong sawmnih ahi a; kongpi sumtawng pua bel huangsung ahi kei hi.
english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

paite: Huan kongpi ponungpen a kipan kongpi sumtawng sunggilpen chiang tong sawmnga ahi.
english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

paite: Huan kongpi sunglam ah akimvel in dantante ah tohlet hon theih louh a-om a, akikal a khuamte ah leng; asumtawngte ah leng, huchibang mah in asunglam ah leng akimvel in tohlet a-om a, akhuamte ah tum sing lim a-om chiat nawn hi.
english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

paite: Huan huangsung ponungzaw ah ahon pi a; ngai dih, dantante a-om a, huangsung kimvel suanglep ahi a; huan, suanglep ah dantan sawmthum a-om hi.
heading: Huang Ponungzaw
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

paite: Huan suanglep bel kongpi a kipan a lep ahi a, kongpi tan ding mah a lep ahi, huai tuh suanglep nuainungzaw ahi.
english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

paite: Huchi in kongpi nuaizaw pen zawn a kipan in huang sungnungzaw pen polam pha in ateh a, azatdan suahlam leh mallam tong zakhat ahi.
english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

paite: Huan huangsung ponungzaw pen kongpi mallam pang a adung leh avai leng ateh hi.
heading: Mallam Kongpi
english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

paite: Huan vilna dantante alang tuak ah thum tuaktuak a-om a, abaangkate leh akongpi sumtawngte leng amasa bang vek ahi; adung tong sawmnga ahi a, avai tong sawmnih-le-nga.
english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Atohlette, asumtawngte, atum sing limte suahlam kongpi toh kikim vek ahi; kalbi sagih a-omtou a; asunglam ah asumtawng a-om hi.
english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

paite: Huang sungnungzaw pen lutna ding kongpi bel kongpi dang zawn ah a-om zel a, mallam leh suahlam ah leng; kongpi leh kongpi kikal ateh a, tong zakhat ahi.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

paite: Huan simlam ah ahon pi nawn a, ngai in, simlam kongpi ana om a; atehdan ngei in abaangkate leh asumtawng ateh hi.
heading: Simlam Kongpi
english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

paite: Huai ah adangte bangmah in akimvel in tohlette a-om a, asumtawng ah leng; adung tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Huan kalbi sagih a-omtou a, asunglam ah sumtawng a-om a; alang tuak abaangkate ah tum sing lim a-om zel hi.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

paite: Simlam ah huang sungnung lutna ding kongpi a-om a, simlam kongpite kikal ateh a, tong zakhat ahi.
english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

paite: Huan simlam kongpi ah huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pi a, tehna ngei in simlam kongpi ateh a;
heading: Huang Sungnung: Simlam Kongpi
english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

paite: vilna dantante, abaangkate sumtawngte tehna mah in huai ah tohlette a-om a, sumtawng leng akimvel in; adunglam tong sawmnga, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

paite: Huan akimvel ah sumtawngte a-om a, adunglam tong sawmnih-le-nga, availam tong nga ahi.
english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

paite: Asumtawngte'n huangsung ponungzaw lam anga a; abaangkate ah tum sing lim a-om a; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Huan suahlam ah huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pi a, atehna ngei in kongpi ateh hi.
heading: Huang Sungnung: Suahlam Kongpi
english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

paite: Avilna dantante, abaangkate, asumtawngte tehna mah in; huai ah tohlette a-om a, sumtawng leng akimvel in; adunglam bel tong sawmnga, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

paite: Asumtawngte'n huangsung ponungzaw pen lam anga a, abaangkate ah lang tuak ah tum sing lim a-om a; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Huan mallam kongpi ah ahon pi nawn a; atehna ngei in ateh a; avilna dantante, abaangkate, asumtawngte;
heading: Huang Sungnung: Mallam Kongpi
english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

paite: huai ah akimvel in tohlette a-om a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Abaangkate huangsung ponungzaw pen lam ah a-om a; abaangkate ah alang tuak ah tum sing lim a-om hi; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Kongpi sumtawng a kipan a lut theih in dantan a-om a, huai ah halmang kithoihna ding asil zel uhi.
heading: Mallam Kongpi Kiang A Innte
english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

paite: Kongpi sumtawng lang tuak ah; halmang kithoihnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a thillatte gohna ding dohkan nih tuak a-om hi.
english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

paite: Mallam kongpi lutna kahtouhna polam sik khat ah dohkan nih a-om a; kongpi sumtawng langkhat ah leng dohkan nih a-om nawn hi.
english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

paite: Huchi in kongpi sik langkhat ah dohkan li a-om a, alangkhat ah dohkan li a-om nawn a; kithoihna gan gohna dohkan giat ahi.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

paite: Huan halmang kithoihna dia dohkan li, suangsek a bawl, adunglam tong khat-le-akim, availam tong khat-le-akim, asanlam tong khat a-om a; huai ah halmang kithoihna leh thillat gohna ding vanzatte akoih zel uhi.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

paite: Huan asunglam ah akimvel in kuaika, khutpek khuh a sau abulh ua; dohkan tungte ah thil latsate a-om hi.
english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pilut a, ngai dih, huang sungnungzaw pen ah dantan nih ana om a; khat pen mallam kongpi chin ah, simlam nga in a-om a, khat pen simlam kongpi chin ah mallam nga in a-om hi.
english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai dantan simlam nga, tempul kemtu siampute omna ahi a;
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

paite: dantan mallam nga maitam kem siampute omna ahi; hiaite Zadok tate, Levi tate lak a ama nna sem ding a TOUPA hong naih sekte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

paite: Huan huangsung ateh a, adunglam tong zakhat, availam tong zakhat, kimvel ahi; maitam bel tempul maitak a om ahi.
heading: Huang Sungnungzaw Leh Tempul Inn
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

paite: Tempul inlim ah ahon pi a, sumtawng baangkate ateh chiat a, alang tuak ah tong nga a sah tuaktuak a-om a, alutna tong sawm leh tong li a za ahi; asik tuak a kongpi baangkate tong thum tuaktuak ahi.
english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

paite: Asumtawng adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawm-le-nih ahi a; luttouhna ah kalbi sawm a-om a, baangka chin ah alang tuak ah khuam lian a-om hi.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
